notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.57 — Fix recorded historical induction attendees being unable to enter the local recruitment Pipeline while an official MBL attendance update is rejected. Candidate profiles with explicit saved Attended evidence now offer 'YES — Proceeding · Add to Pipeline'. This action is local-only, asks for confirmation, retains the genuine past attendance date (e.g. Abdul Nasser Bayorbor, 12 October), preserves the official booking and pending/review attendance warning, does not retry or discard official writes, and NEVER automatically claims Contract Sent. Existing genuine contract steps, Pipeline timer history, contact notes, and candidate history are preserved; the new initial Pipeline stopwatch starts at the actual moment tracking begins instead of inventing an earlier timestamp. The Hub immediately opens the candidate's Pipeline with the next step. An official MBL refresh now preserves the locally verified induction date instead of overwriting it with an incorrect still-Confirmed booking. Clear Not Attended, Not Proceeding, removed or final hiring outcomes are blocked from unreviewed promotion. No real candidate or official MBL data is changed by installing. Automatic cross-device cloud sync remains disabled and separately under testing.
